name: Mogyoród (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and green in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Mogyoród: a red and white shield with a hazel bough, a church and a bunch of grapes, with a helm, a patriarchal cross crest and red, yellow and grey mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Mogyoród arms with helm, crest and mantling
